messages:
anya: heads-up: premerge scans for PR #9821 flagged a mixed bag: SAST hits around keystore usage and a DAST proof showing a rendered config fragment on /debug/info. artifact: gs://ci/9821/scan.json

diego: can you paste the snippets?

anya: from the artifact:
```
SAST: config/service.go:131 - keystore.Decrypt(envKey) -> rule RDX-KMS-021
DAST: POST /debug/info -> response body contains evaluated config snippet
```

maria: tagging @kevin from infra 9 any recent RBAC tweaks or key rotations for debug service?

kevin: we rotated the debug keystore key yesterday and ran a scripted grant to the rollout-sa for 10m. No intentional RBAC changes otherwise. I'll grab audit logs.

security-bot: scan summary: 1 HIGH (possible secret leak), 6 MED. Triage rec: assign owner, reproduce in staging, attach KMS audit, check SDLC review flow for keystore.Decrypt uses.

oncall-sre: I can repro in staging and replay the grant. If the grant had decrypt scope that would explain transient exposure.

diego: I'll pick up SAST triage and grep for keystore.Decrypt across repos, add linter rule proposal.

anya: I created ticket SEC-10244 and linked the artifact. please attach audit slice and repro notes. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/SEC-10244

kevin: attached the keystore audit entries for the rotation window to the ticket. grant id G-9910 shows decrypt present for rollout-sa for 12m due to an automation bug.

diego: quick code excerpt added to SEC-10244:
```
// service.go
secret, _ := keystore.Decrypt(os.Getenv("DEBUG_KEY"))
fmt.Fprintf(w, "debug:%s", secret)
```
This should never be called on debug endpoints. I'll open PR to fail closed and to add a static analyzer rule that flags keystore.Decrypt in handlers under /debug or /public.

maria: mitigation: patch to redact secrets on debug endpoints and to update the automation so rollout-SA grants do not include decrypt. kevin can you fix the grant script?

kevin: yes, fixing automation now and will add a unit test to ensure decrypt flag cannot be set by the rollout flow. Also updating keystore-change playbook to require two approvers for decrypt grants.

oncall-sre: repro notes: replayed G-9910 in sandbox; confirmed /debug/info returned the decrypted fragment only when decrypt grant active. audit shows automation user ci-ops created the grant. exporting logs to SEC-10244.

diego: opened WIP PR https://github.com/redwood/config/pull/2048 to fail closed, add sanitizer, and add a comment to SAST rule set. Also proposing PLCY-KMS-07 linter rule that forbids keystore.Decrypt in code under handlers/debug or handlers/public.

anya: added action items to SEC-10244: diego->SAST fix + linter proposal, kevin->automation fix + playbook update, oncall-sre->audit export and repro notes, maria->Dast re-run and ingress redaction. ETA 48h for full rollout.

maria: DAST re-run in staging after hotfix shows no evaluated fragments and only low-severity noise remaining. Logging results in SEC-10244.

security-bot: Reminder: all ephemeral RBAC grants must include ticket reference and be recorded in the keystore-change log. Consider adding automated CI check to block merges that add Decrypt calls.

kevin: automation fix merged, added test; rolled back accidental grants and applied two-approver requirement. audit slices in ticket.

diego: linter rule PLCY-KMS-07 submitted as RFC to devex. If accepted we'll enforce in premerge.

anya: thanks everyone. closing this Slack thread; keeping SEC-10244 open for postmortem and policy follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
